name: Revolution Square
description: The square where the 1989 revolution came to a head, lined by the former Communist Party headquarters and the old Royal Palace.

name: Palace of the Parliament
description: Ceaușescu’s enormous government palace, one of the largest buildings in the world, built over a cleared historic district. Guided tours run inside.

name: Romanian Athenaeum
description: A domed 19th-century concert hall, home of the city’s philharmonic orchestra, with a painted fresco running around the main hall.

name: University Square
description: A busy central square by the university, scene of street fighting in the 1989 revolution and of a long anti-government protest in 1990.
